notes: *fourteenth* is one English word for אַרְבַּע עֶשְׂרֵה, so the two share a unit (rule 30); splitting it would leave one morpheme unrendered.

The single *the* of *all the fortified cities* goes to the attributive's present article, since the construct noun could carry none (rule 47); the fronted *did* is the verb's own, no interrogative standing in the clause (rule 17). The margin's *Sanherib* was read and set aside (rule 38).
